block.title: Shunt sampling
block.summary: Reads the phase currents through shunts in the stage, as a low-cost drive does: each reading needs its switch on long enough, and a phase that cannot be read is made from the others or held.
block.definition: Reads the phase currents through resistors in the stage, where a cheap drive has no current sensor. Three or two shunts sit under the low switches: a phase is read at the carrier's peak while its low switch is on, which it is for (1 − d)·Ts, and needs that to be at least the window the amplifier and the converter take to settle and sample. Of three, the two with the longest windows are read and the third made from them; of two (phases a and b), each is read where it can be. One shunt in the DC link reads, in each of the period's two active vectors, the current of the leg alone in its state: two phases a period, the third made from them, each read where its vector stands for the window, in the period before the instant. A phase that cannot be read keeps its last reading, made to sum to nought with what was read; `held` says when. At a high modulation a low-side shunt's window closes; at a low one, and wherever two references meet, a DC-link shunt's does.
math: \text{DC link: } i_{dc} = \sum_{x\ \text{high}} i_x,\quad \text{read where the vector stands} \ge t_w

inputs.name: i_a
inputs.about: phase a current, at the sampling instant

inputs.name: i_b
inputs.about: phase b current, at the sampling instant

inputs.name: i_c
inputs.about: phase c current, at the sampling instant

inputs.name: window_a
inputs.about: leg a's low switch on about the instant

inputs.name: window_b
inputs.about: leg b's low switch on about the instant

inputs.name: window_c
inputs.about: leg c's low switch on about the instant

inputs.name: i_dc_1
inputs.about: the DC link's current in the first active vector

inputs.name: i_dc_2
inputs.about: the DC link's current in the second active vector

outputs.name: held
outputs.about: 1 where a phase could not be read and its last reading was kept

params.name: shunts
params.about: three or two under the low switches, or one in the DC link

params.name: window
params.about: the least time a shunt must carry its phase to be read

params.name: fix
params.about: what the timer does where a window would be too short: shift the edges so it is not (the legs together under low-side shunts, the vectors apart under one in the DC link), or nothing

params.name: noise
params.about: gaussian noise on each reading, rms

params.name: bits
params.about: resolution of the converter; 0 for none

params.name: full_scale
params.about: current at the converter's full scale, either way

sources.name: inverter.window_a
sources.about: time leg a's low switch was on about this instant, the period before

sources.name: inverter.window_b
sources.about: time leg b's low switch was on about this instant, the period before

sources.name: inverter.window_c
sources.about: time leg c's low switch was on about this instant, the period before

sources.name: inverter.i_dc_1
sources.about: DC-link current at the end of the period's first active vector, the period before

sources.name: inverter.vector_1
sources.about: the legs high in that vector, as a number: a 1, b 2, c 4 (0: no vector)

sources.name: inverter.i_dc_2
sources.about: DC-link current at the end of the period's second active vector, the period before

sources.name: inverter.vector_2
sources.about: the legs high in that vector, as a number: a 1, b 2, c 4 (0: no vector)
